title: Lunar16x
body:
Hey, this is my official PvP texture pack made by 1tzLunar. I made this mainly for PvP and Crystal PvP (CPvP), so everything in it is focused on making fights feel cleaner, smoother, and easier to track.
(IF THERE IS A MASSAGE WHILE LOADING THE PACK, SIMPLY IGNORE IT)
I tried to keep it simple and not too distracting, because in PvP you don’t really want a bunch of flashy stuff blocking your vision. The swords, particles, and UI are all edited to help you see better during fights and focus more on your aim and timing instead of visual clutter.

This pack works really well for modes like Diapot, Nethpot, and other competitive PvP servers where fast reactions and good mechanics actually matter. It’s especially helpful for stuff like hit trading (aggro), combos, and general close-range fights where every hit counts.

I also made sure it stays lightweight so it doesn’t drop your FPS. It should run fine on most PCs, whether you have a high-end setup or something more low-end.

Overall, this pack is just something I made for people who want a clean PvP experience without unnecessary stuff. If you like simple, competitive packs that actually help in fights, you’ll probably like this one.
